label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 246 ]

blocks.text: Darwin was the first to propose that long necks evolved in giraffes because they enabled the animals to eat the treetop leaves.
(A)So Simmons became convinced that this competition for mates, not stretching for treetop food, was what drove the evolution of the neck.

(B)This seemingly reasonable explanation has held up for over a century, but it is probably wrong, says Robert Simmons, a behavioral ecologist. Simmons was studying eagles in Africa when he came across a pair of male giraffes locked in combat.

(C)He saw the male giraffes battling for mates by swinging their powerful necks, which were over six feet long and weighed more than 200 pounds. He observed that in contests of this type, males with the longest, thickest necks usually won.

readingSentences.english: Darwin was the first to propose that long necks evolved in giraffes because they enabled the animals to eat the treetop leaves.
readingSentences.korean: 다윈은 기린이 높은 나뭇잎을 먹을 수 있게 해주었기 때문에 긴 목이 진화했다고 최초로 제안했다.

readingSentences.english: So Simmons became convinced that this competition for mates, not stretching for treetop food, was what drove the evolution of the neck.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 시몬스는 높은 나뭇잎을 먹기 위해 목을 늘린 것이 아니라, 짝을 차지하기 위한 이러한 경쟁이 목의 진화를 이끌었다고 확신하게 되었다.

readingSentences.english: This seemingly reasonable explanation has held up for over a century, but it is probably wrong, says Robert Simmons, a behavioral ecologist.
readingSentences.korean: 겉보기에 타당해 보이는 이 설명은 1세기 이상 유지되어 왔지만, 행동 생태학자인 로버트 시몬스에 따르면 아마도 틀렸을 것이라고 한다.

readingSentences.english: Simmons was studying eagles in Africa when he came across a pair of male giraffes locked in combat.
readingSentences.korean: 시몬스는 아프리카에서 독수리를 연구하던 중 격투를 벌이고 있는 수컷 기린 한 쌍을 우연히 목격했다.

readingSentences.english: He saw the male giraffes battling for mates by swinging their powerful necks, which were over six feet long and weighed more than 200 pounds.
readingSentences.korean: 그는 6피트가 넘고 무게가 200파운드가 넘는 강력한 목을 휘두르며 짝을 차지하기 위해 싸우는 수컷 기린들을 보았다.

readingSentences.english: He observed that in contests of this type, males with the longest, thickest necks usually won.
readingSentences.korean: 그는 이러한 유형의 경쟁에서는 가장 길고 굵은 목을 가진 수컷이 대개 승리한다는 것을 관찰했다.
